blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The number of visitors at Manila North Cemetery reached nearly 1.4 million on Nov. 1 as All Saints’ Day fell on a weekend, the Manila Police District (MPD) said on Monday. MPD spokesperson Maj. Philipp Ines said the figure covered visitors recorded from 5 a.m. to 9 p.m. “We expect that because it [November 1] fell on a Sunday,” Ines said in an ambush interview. READ: LIVE UPDATES: Undas 2026 | Nov. 2 He said the cemetery recorded only around 1.1 million visitors during the same period last year.
